# Live status

> Always-mounted polite status region that announces changes to assistive technology.

This file matches the installed `live-status` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/live-status.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/live-status.md`.

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/ui/live-status`: `LiveStatus`, types `LiveStatusProps`

## Composition

### Polite announcement

Keep it mounted and change only its message.

```tsx
<LiveStatus />
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button";
import { LiveStatus } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/live-status";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

export function PrimitiveLiveStatusExample() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const message = count === 0 ? "" : `${count} ${count === 1 ? "file" : "files"} uploaded`;

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col items-start gap-3">
      <Button variant="surface" size="sm" onClick={() => setCount((value) => value + 1)}>
        Upload file
      </Button>
      <Text as="p" size="label" tone="muted" aria-hidden="true">
        {message || "Nothing uploaded yet"}
      </Text>
      <LiveStatus message={message} />
    </div>
  );
}
```
